storyink 0.4.0: content steps in the story engine
The compiler grows a content pass; storyState and the camera learn about it. Render with --changes storyink-0.4.0.changes.json

svg.text: Steps compile to a timeline; storyState(t) draws any frame from it
0.4 adds a content pass to the compiler
storyState hands content events to a new contentFrame
contentFrame applies typing, versions, bars, levels and wires
The follow camera frames content events too
